assertions: The response routes Sector/Track-local drawing to the plot-primitives sub-skill.
The response adds a padded track with sector.add_track((70,100), r_pad_ratio=0.1, ...) and explains that data maps into track.r_plot_lim after padding.
The response passes the same explicit vmin=0 and vmax=1 to the line, scatter, and fill_between calls and explains that an omitted vmax is inferred per call and breaks visual comparability.
The response keeps x values inside the sector range 1..19 and states that x_to_rad() is for inspection/custom integration, not for pre-converting public primitive arguments.
The response adds a grid and ticks using Track.grid / xticks_by_interval / yticks as documented in the api-reference.
The response does not route this workflow to circular-composition or data-parsers as its owner.
